# California State Government Portal (ca.gov)

> > Official portal for California state services, including CalCareers state employment, municipal services, and environmental management programs like the Salton Sea Management Program.

Ca.gov serves as the umbrella domain for California state and municipal government websites, providing access to state employment through CalCareers (managed by CalHR), city services like Sunnyvale's municipal portal, and environmental initiatives managed by the California Natural Resources Agency and Department of Water Resources.

## Key Topics

- CalCareers - California state job search portal
- CalHR - California Department of Human Resources
- State employment and job classifications
- Salton Sea Management Program (SSMP)
- Habitat restoration and Species Conservation
- Air quality and dust suppression
- California Natural Resources Agency
- California Department of Water Resources
- Municipal services and city government
- Pacific Flyway conservation
- Governor Gavin Newsom administration
- Occupational groups and career categories
- Open City Hall community engagement
- Environmental management programs

## State Employment & CalCareers

- [CalCareers](https://calcareers.ca.gov/): California state government job search portal by CalHR
- [CalCareers - Job Application Steps](https://calcareers.ca.gov/CalHRPublic/Landing/Jobs/Steps.aspx): Step-by-step guide for California state job application process
- [CalCareers - New to State Service](https://calcareers.ca.gov/CalHRPublic/Landing/NewToStateservice.aspx): Guide for new applicants to California state government job categories
- [CalCareers - Current State Employees](https://calcareers.ca.gov/CalHRPublic/Landing/StateEmployees.aspx): Job search guide for current California state employees

## Environmental Management Programs

- [Salton Sea Management Program](https://saltonsea.ca.gov/): Salton Sea habitat restoration & air quality management by CA Natural Resources

## Municipal Services

- [Sunnyvale, CA | Home](https://www.sunnyvale.ca.gov/home): Sunnyvale city homepage with Access Sunnyvale and Open City Hall services

## Optional

- [CalCareers - Typing Certification](http://beta.calcareers.ca.gov/CalHRPublic/GeneralInfo/TypingCertification.aspx): Typing certification requirements for CA state clerical positions
